'''Astina Griek''' was a lowborn [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on [[Hargeeva]]. She had a [[Astina Griek's husband|husband]] and a [[Astina Griek's son|son]] who were [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. She eventually joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], serving at [[Eyrie Base]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], she was killed by Imperial [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Nial Pedrin]].<ref name="J10" />
